title: Heavenly Winds Give Us Real Life
body:
Dastoor yaa Sayyidee. (Mawlana Shaykh stands.) Madad, madad. Madad, madad. Madad, madad yaa
Saahibu ‘l-Imdaad. Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, laa ilaaha illa-Llah, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, wa lillahi 'lhamd! Allahumma salli wa sallim wa baarik `alaa Sayyidina Muhammad (s), Sayyidi ‘l-aawwaleen wa’laakhireen `abduka wa habeebuka wa Rasooluk! Zidhu yaa Rabbee, `izzan wa sharafan, nooran wa suroora,
sultaanan wa ridwaana. (Mawlana Shaykh sits.)
Allah, Allah. Thumma as-salaatu wa’s-salaam `ala jami` al-anbiya wa ’l-awliya. Allahuma zidhu `izzan wa
sharafan nooran wa suroora, ridwaana wa sultaana. Thumma salaamu `alayk yaa Sahib az-Zamaan. Thumma
salaamun` alayka yaa Qutb al-Mutasarrif for dunya, for this planet. Madad, yaa RijaalAllah.
We know nothing. We are asking to learn as much as possible and we are saying, as-salaamu `alaykum, our
attenders. We are weak servants. But for the honor of the Seal of Prophets (s), the Lord of Heavens is sending
riyaah, that means giving life to people; that wind is coming from heavens and reaching people. Because that
heavenly wind gives us real-life-attention, and real-life-power is coming through that wind, as winds in the
springtime give life to nature and an opening comes.
In such a way, heavenly winds are reaching from Heavens to some ones on this dunya. Who is prepared for

spring winds, they reach from heavens and give life to nature. And now we are asking for heavenly winds to
reach us, to make us blessed ones. That heavenly wind gives us real life's power. Who is asking to be in a good
position in this life and after it, must give their attention to accept that heavenly wind to reach their physical
being. Then their physical being will take its share, and then their spirituality, their real being.
No one knows the beginning of our spirituality. We may know our tazhahur, our physical appearance here,
but when did our heavenly appearance begin, because there is no time there. In the line of pre-Eternal to
Eternal, there is no time. And we may say that appearances from Creation Oceans are reaching and coming in
existence at any time. Therefore, now on this planet, we are in need of winds to come and give us something
from heavenly grants of our Lord. Therefore, whoever is asking to live hayaatun tayyibah, a good and joyful
life, must hope to reach heavenly winds. They may say, “We must be ready to receive winds from heavens and
prepared for this to come to us.” We are saying this and asking for heavenly winds in every association! They
give our physical being and our spirituality pleasures and enjoyment!
O our Attenders! Try to be present at such meetings that are supported by Heavens. Run and take that
heavenly pleasure and enjoyment, or you will be on this planet in darkness! Who is entering darkness, fear
covers him and he becomes blind! He can't see, hear, taste, or be joyful. But people are running after material
enjoyment, which is zero, never giving anything to Mankind.
O our Attenders! Leave everything for a short time and ask for heavenly pleasure through the heavenly,
windy waves that reach Earth to accept that one. Ask to reach a real life here so that you will not be dust in
your graves! Your physical being also will be protected in Earth; it is not so important, but your spirituality
needs heavenly pleasure, satisfaction and enjoyment so that it may also reach heavenly Beauty Oceans. You
can't enter those oceans with your material being, no.
Countless thanks, praising and glorifying to our Most Mighty and Most Majestic Lord, the Lord of the all
Creation! And we are saying, a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem. That is a grant from Heavens. You
must run after it to take even one precious stone, one diamond, one ruby or emerald. Reach and take even
one! That is a chance we have been granted. Why are you so heedless? In front of you are heaps of jewels:
diamonds, pearls, rubies and emeralds! Why are you not opening your eyes and taking as much as possible?
O our Attenders! As-salaamu `alaykum. Say, a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem! What they are

making me speak now is a preface to a precious meeting preparing people to reach real pearl, diamond or
ruby fields! They are not small ones, but heaps! And if a man is going to be happy with a small ruby or a small
diamond, what if he is looking at a heap of shining diamonds? How will he be if it is said to him, "That is for
you!"
O our Lord, make that enemy of Mankind to be far away from us! Shaytan comes from so many manfaz,
finding so many ways to reach people to make them heedless from huge mounds of jewels. You may enjoy
this dunya, but our life is an endless grant from Allah Almighty and our souls are never going to die. After a
while our physical being is going to finish and fall dead. But what is pleasurable to Man that understands
everything, is the most valuable jewel and it belongs to our spirituality.
O heedless Ones! As-salaamu `alaykum to you once again. All of us are heedless, running after dunya and
leaving real, valuable grants of our Lord. That is the last limit of being heedless. But Shaytan's tricks are
making people to fall in it. Therefore, Allah Almighty is saying: (Mawlana Shaykh stands)
••••••••• ••••••• •••••••••• ••••••• ••••••••••••••
Wa dhakkir, fa-inna ‘dh-dhikra tanfa`u ‘l-mu’mineen, But remind, for reminder benefits the Believers. (al
Dhariyaat, 51:55)
(Mawlana Shaykh sits) "O My most beloved one! Say to My servants that in front of them are so many
heavenly grants, such that eyes have never seen or ears never heard, that which never reached our ability to
understand. I am preparing that for My servants."
`Adattu li `ibaadee as-saaliheen ma laa `aynun ra’at wa laa udhunun sami`at wa laa khatara `ala qalbi bashr,
I have prepared for My servants who are My sincere worshippers, what no eye has ever seen, nor any ear has
ever heard, nor has ever come to heart of a man.
O Salafi `ulama! As-salaamu `alaykum, The Wahabis do not understand; their understanding imprisons
them in between four walls and they are not able to destroy those four walls to look at what is in existence.
They are putting people in prisons, not move in any direction, and people are thinking that Allah Almighty is
sending Islam for imprisoning His servants. No! But they are saying, “Yes.” The Wahabis say, “Allah is
sending heavenly orders for imprisoning His servants and therefore, we also are imprisoning people in kufr,

shirk, haraam and bida` so that they can’t move in any direction!”
No, Allah Almighty is not sending His heavenly orders to imprison His servants!! Allah Almighty is only
sending them so that the Children of Adam may defeat Shaytan and its followers. Allah Almighty created
Adam and Eve (a) and put them in Paradise, not prison!
O Wahabi people and Salafi `ulama! Understand that you are confining people in a prison! No, Allah
Almighty only created Adam, wa askanahum, to reside in Paradise. Allah Almighty created Man to grant
them from His endless Grant Oceans, not to put Mankind in prison! But Shaytan is making his followers’ life
as a prison for Mankind. No! No!
Allah Almighty is showing His servants the first lifestyle, saying, “I have created you for Paradise. Listen to
Me, follow Me and obey Me, and you will be here forever. But there will be a most terrible enemy against you,
Shaytan. He never accepted to bow down to your father, Adam. Beware of that one; it wants to take you away
from Paradise. And beyond Paradise there is only punishment, miseries, sufferings, troubles, bad things, and
only darkness; nothing else! I created eight paradises for you, to give to you from My ni`mat, endless grants.
But that one, Shaytan, wants to put you in a prison with no possibility to get out, where you are never going
to be happy. From everywhere punishment comes and there is always something that gives you trouble,
miseries and suffering; that is Shaytan's target! But I have created you and put you in Paradise. I like that you
should be there forever. But Shaytan, your most terrible enemy, wants you to be in prison always!”
Awliyaa never like Mankind to be in prison, but Shaytan and its followers always want people be in prison;
not to look and see, not to hear and understand, and not to eat and enjoy, but to have a bad taste. Shaytan
always wants Man to be mahroom, deprived. Therefore, Allah Almighty ordered His most honored one, "Say
to your nation, for their dealings be mu`amalaat with each other, they must follow My command and My
wish! I am sending My holy command through you.
••••• ••• •••••• • •••••• ••• ••••••
yassiroo wa laa tu`assiroo wa bashshiroo wa laa tunaffiroo, “Make it easy, not difficult; give good tidings and
don't cause repulsion.”
O Salafi `ulamas! Marhaban! Are you accepting, or for every step are you putting something to prevent

people from moving? You are doing your best to make their lives hard and imprison them! You never give
them heavenly pleasures; instead, you say, “ No, haraam, bida`, shirk, kufr!” How are you giving pleasures to
them? How will they move? It is better to say, “O People! Your Lord created you in Paradise and wants you to
be there up to Eternity. He has prepared Eternity for you!”
It is a very hard time now, because so many people claim to know something, saying they are directing and
guiding people to Truth. No, your guidance never shows people the ways to Paradise! You are always cutting
that road, making people to fall into Hellfire! May Allah forgive us.
O People! Listen and obey, love and be happy, and you will be protected. May Allah forgive us, for the honor
of Sayyidina Muhammad (s)! (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits)
Fatihah.
(Mawlana Shaykh prays two rakaats Salat ash-Shukr.)
(41 minutes.) Enough.
Yaa Allah.
How many people? (639) Getting up.
